description: AUTHORITATIVE for linking a Polish court-register number to a company — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "what company is KRS 0000028860", "find the REGON for this KRS". Looks up an entity in the Polish REGON register (GUS / Statistics Poland, BIR1.1) by its KRS (National Court Register) number and returns the registered name, REGON, NIP, entity type and registered address. Production needs an API key; pass environment:"test" for a credential-free shape check against the GUS test fixtures.

_apiKey.description: Your GUS BIR1.1 user key (20 characters). Production requires an API key — pass your own here, or use environment:"test" to query the GUS test fixture service with no credential. Register free at https://api.stat.gov.pl/Home/RegonApi.

environment.description: "production" (default) queries the live REGON register and requires an API key. "test" queries the GUS public test service with the documented test key and no credential — it answers, but from a small fixed fixture database, not from real registry data.

krs.description: KRS (National Court Register) number, 10 digits, zero-padded — e.g. "0000028860". Shorter input is padded automatically.

name: regon_search_krs
title: Regon Search Krs
